title: sail could draw its default seed from std instead of rand
body: `sail` depends on `rand` for one `u64`, drawn when `--seed` is absent, in `shuffle`, `sample` and `skim`. `std::hash::RandomState` would cover that call. Dropping `rand` removes its dependency tree from `sail`'s build.
close_reason: Landed in 5402129 on dev. default_seed in sail/src/commands/mod.rs hashes nothing with a fresh RandomState; std has no stable random API on 1.98.
